Symboli Rudolf had been working hard for 
the sake of the Umamusume since the New 
Year. Just then, word reached her that Air 
Groove had collapsed.

Though the collapse was simply due to 
overwork, Symboli Rudolf blamed herself 
for failing her duties as president in 
managing her well-being.

However, Air Groove denounced her, saying 
she was in the wrong. Symboli Rudolf took 
those words to heart with great gravity.
